name: PerformYard
summary: PerformYard publishes only a range for its Performance plan, $5 to $15 per person per month, billed annually, with the exact rate depending on headcount and products. Reviews, goals, feedback and meetings are in one plan, and a success manager and implementation are included.

facts.text: The review page says HR teams define their own questions, timelines and touchpoints for review cycles.
A dedicated success manager, hands-on implementation, HRIS integrations and SSO are included with every plan, with no separate onboarding or training fees.
The pricing calculator shows no computed figure, so a specific price needs a quote.

plans.name: Performance
plans.notes: Listed as a range of $5 to $15, billed annually. Reviews, meetings, goals, engagement, feedback and surveys

plans.name: Talent Development
plans.notes: Listed as a range of $5 to $15, billed annually. Compensation, coaching, competencies, succession planning and career pathing

hiddenCosts: The page states no minimum seat count or contract minimum, and says volume pricing is available.
